requires_6.commit_identifier_note: Abbreviated development commit supplied with the raw job receipt; raw report/probe/11 provenance identities are exact.

actual_native_failures: Nonrequiring transpose still carried an AD op and cmd90 rejected it with status 5.
Enabling a forward nonrequiring input later incorrectly created a gradient edge.

host_schema_error.detail: The first six-case replay incorrectly expected the 24-case group-inventory fields. Its original KeyError report is retained. V2 only adapts the missing observation fields to fixed constructor-input checks and observed per-parameter state entry counts; all recipe and numeric/identity comparison methods remain AST-identical.

history.retention_policy: Every original report, executed source, request and response is copied byte for byte. No candidate-06 evidence is relabeled as candidate-08.

numeric_policy: Exact unsigned binary32 words, including signed zero; exact parameter/state Versions and gradient presence. No floating tolerance.
identity_policy: Reference opaque identity relationships map to observed native stable Tensor incarnations or live public tokens and typed Storage IDs; host addresses are never compared.
open_scope: Public .grad Tensor identity, layout, Storage aliases and Version are not exposed; only exact words and None presence are compared.
Python warning objects, mutable group dictionaries and intrusive_ptr reference counts are not implemented by this wire API.
Arbitrary late-error partial Optimizer mutation behavior is not claimed; native Optimizer commands are frame atomic.
The fixed literal alias mutation in case 16 is not a Tensor.add_ implementation.
Actual retained-nonleaf Optimizer membership is accepted by Torch but lacks a native retain_grad interface (one partial case).
External public grad aliases (case 20) and actual Adam/AdamW state objects (cases 21–24) remain not executed.
The additional three AccumulateGrad lifetime recipes are separately PREPARED/NOT_RUN in this frozen package; their later actual observations and qualification must use an additive receipt.
count_policy: Do not sum separate suites, repeated trajectories, or scalar comparisons into unique upstream tests or API coverage. Twenty-four reference cases are not twenty-four native passes.
historical_path_policy: Absolute paths inside raw development receipts are historical execution context, not a promise those local paths remain available. Package manifest paths are repository-relative.
